topic: Dhana yogas — the classical list and the strict conditions everyone drops (DD deep-dive reel, English, 2026-08-26 pm)

slides.sub: Everyone lists them. Almost nobody checks the conditions.

slides.body:
Dhana means wealth; a yoga is a specific, named planetary combination. So a dhana yoga is a defined link between the lords of the wealth-related houses — the 1st, 2nd, 5th, 9th and 11th.

The link must be a real one: conjunction, mutual aspect, exchange of signs, or one lord sitting in the other's house. A vague "good planet in a good house" is not a yoga.

points: 2nd lord in the 11th and 11th lord in the 2nd — the classic exchange
2nd lord with the 5th or 9th lord — earnings meeting merit
Lakshmi yoga — 9th lord dignified in a kendra, with a strong lagna lord
Chandra-Mangala yoga — Moon and Mars in relationship
Gaja Kesari — Jupiter in a kendra from the Moon (status, not cash)

slides.body:
Kendra — the angular houses, 1, 4, 7, 10. Trikona — the trines, 1, 5, 9. Classical texts treat a yoga formed across kendra and trikona as the strongest kind.

A yoga sitting in a dusthana (the difficult houses 6, 8, 12) is not cancelled, but it is muffled — it delivers less, later, and with more friction.

points: Dignity — a yoga built from debilitated or combust lords underdelivers
Placement — the yoga must sit where it can express itself
Dasha — the planetary period system; without the dasha of a participating planet, the yoga stays on paper
No dasha, no timing. This is the single most-dropped condition.
Navamsa (D9) — the ninth-part divisional chart, read for inner strength
Ashtakavarga — the benefic-point scoring system; count the bindus on the 2nd and 11th
Affliction — links to the 6th, 8th or 12th lords dilute the result
Yoga-bhanga — the classical cancellation clauses, which texts state explicitly

slides.body:
No yoga guarantees wealth. Not one on this list, not all of them together.

Jyotish describes a tendency and a season, not an outcome. Anyone who reads a name off a chart and promises you money is skipping every condition on these slides — and the texts themselves are stricter than that.

Pick one dhana yoga you have been told you have, then test it against all six conditions above.

Comment “dhana” with what you find, and save this reel — it is a working checklist, not a list of names.
